$comment: One entry per lemma. `pos` selects which inflection fields are meaningful. `forms` is the authoritative surface-form map used for auto-resolution of unannotated words; keys are form names, values are the Norwegian surface strings.

datter.note: Feminine nouns take either -en or -a in the definite singular. 'dattera' is the everyday spoken form; 'datteren' is equally correct.

voksen.gloss: adult, grown-up (in barnehage context: staff member)

klær.note: Plural only — there is no singular form in use.

henge opp.note: Separable verb: the particle 'opp' detaches in main clauses.

på grunn av.note: Fixed prepositional phrase; always three words.

kone.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «kona» or «konen». Both are correct bokmål.

søster.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «søstera» or «søsteren». Both are correct bokmål.

mor.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «mora» or «moren». Both are correct bokmål.

uke.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «uka» or «uken». Both are correct bokmål.

helg.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «helga» or «helgen». Both are correct bokmål.

helse.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «helsa» or «helsen». Both are correct bokmål.

hus.pron: u is tight, lips forward, like French u

husleie.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «husleia» or «husleien». Both are correct bokmål.

fritid.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «fritida» or «fritiden». Both are correct bokmål.

tid.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «tida» or «tiden». Both are correct bokmål.

mene.gloss: to mean, to be of the opinion

for det første.note: Discourse marker for ordering arguments; pairs with 'for det andre'.

gå ut på.gloss: to be about, to consist of

ha lyst til.gloss: to feel like, to want to

side.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «sida» or «siden». Both are correct bokmål.

framtid.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «framtida» or «framtiden». Both are correct bokmål.

stue.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «stua» or «stuen». Both are correct bokmål.

melk.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «melka» or «melken». Both are correct bokmål.

egg.note: Irregular: unchanged in the indefinite plural.

suppe.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «suppa» or «suppen». Both are correct bokmål.

frukt.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «frukta» or «frukten». Both are correct bokmål.

kake.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «kaka» or «kaken». Both are correct bokmål.

nese.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «nesa» or «nesen». Both are correct bokmål.

dør.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «døra» or «døren». Both are correct bokmål.

seng.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «senga» or «sengen». Both are correct bokmål.

lampe.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «lampa» or «lampen». Both are correct bokmål.

klokke.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «klokka» or «klokken». Both are correct bokmål.

avtale.note: Definite singular is avtalen, not avtaleen.

sol.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «sola» or «solen». Both are correct bokmål.

sky.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «skya» or «skyen». Both are correct bokmål.

elv.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «elva» or «elven». Both are correct bokmål.

jakke.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «jakka» or «jakken». Both are correct bokmål.

bukse.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «buksa» or «buksen». Both are correct bokmål.

skjorte.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «skjorta» or «skjorten». Both are correct bokmål.

sko.note: Irregular: unchanged in the indefinite plural.

lue.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «lua» or «luen». Both are correct bokmål.

gate.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «gata» or «gaten». Both are correct bokmål.

kino.pron: «hyi-no»: k before i is the kj-sound

kirke.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «kirka» or «kirken». Both are correct bokmål.

lekse.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «leksa» or «leksen». Both are correct bokmål.

lønn.note: Feminine noun: definite singular is «lønna» or «lønnen». Both are correct bokmål.

passe.gloss: to fit, to suit; to mind

lei seg.note: Fixed expression: «å være lei seg». Does not inflect.

tre (substantiv).note: Irregular plural: trær. Distinct from the numeral «tre» (three).

dyr (substantiv).note: Unchanged in the indefinite plural. Distinct from the adjective «dyr» (expensive).

trives.gloss: to thrive, to enjoy being somewhere
trives.note: A deponent verb: the -s form is the only form. 'Jeg trives på jobben' = I like it at work.

lur.gloss: smart, clever ('det er lurt å' = it is wise to)

tjene.gloss: to earn ('tjene på' = to benefit from)

spansk.note: Also the name of the language: 'jeg snakker spansk'.

engelsk.note: Also the name of the language: 'jeg snakker engelsk'.

før.note: Also a preposition and adverb: 'før klokka ni', 'som før'.

etter at.note: 'etter' alone goes before a noun: etter jobben. Before a whole clause it is 'etter at': etter at jeg kom hjem.

tur.gloss: walk, trip ('gå en tur' = go for a walk)

ei.note: Optional: every feminine noun also takes «en». «ei bok» and «en bok» are both correct.

midt.gloss: in the middle ('midt på dagen' = in the middle of the day)

samboer.note: Very common in Norway: a partner you live with without being married.

spille.note: «leke» is to play as children do; «spille» is games, sport and music.

glede seg.gloss: to look forward to ('glede seg til')

hensyn.gloss: consideration, regard ('ta hensyn til' = take into account)

begrunne.gloss: to justify, to give reasons for

ta hensyn til.gloss: to take into account, to consider

nemlig.gloss: namely; you see (gives the reason after the fact)

bønne.pron: tone 2: «bøn-ner» with a rising-falling melody — «bønder» (farmers) has the other tone

$idComment: Every entry carries a stable `id` (<lemma>-<pos>). Annotations and SRS state should reference the id, not the lemma string: lemmas get renamed and can collide across parts of speech, ids do not.
